verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 remains approval-worthy. The implementation is report-only and fail-closed: it refuses absent or malformed secret inventories, malformed or numerically ambiguous claim inventories, missing tokens, unsafe repository names, truncated or failed API listings, and never offers a claim-ref mutation path. The workflow exposes the full secrets context only to the filtering step, passes only filtered names to the reporter, preserves the dispatch-secrets environment binding, and lets reporting failures remain loud without blocking the repair sweep. The tests exercise the real CLI entry point and pagination boundary, prove nonzero/no-report refusals, verify GET-only behavior, and structurally bind the workflow producer, consumer, ordering, environment, exact command, and absence of disabling conditions or deletion flags. No blocker, major, minor, or nit is supported by the diff. Because round 2 already had no findings and this round remains at zero, progress is stagnant under the prescribed comparison scale rather than improving.
